title: TURL: table understanding through representation learning

locations.paragraph: Table pre-training can encode additional structural information. title: WebTables: exploring the power of tables on the web

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners

locations.paragraph: KGLink's use of external knowledge depends on the coverage of the existing graph and the labeled data available for fine-tuning. When a suitable graph is unavailable or new labels arrive with few examples~\cite{gorag-xia-etal-2021-incremental}, the system needs another way to obtain and use knowledge. Few-shot prompting shows that a language model can adapt its predictions through input examples~\cite{lit-brown2020language}, while meta-learning studies adaptation from limited supervision~\cite{lit-finn2017model}. These approaches motivate us to explore using a large language model's semantic capabilities with a graph constructed from task data. To support this setting, we propose GORAG for dynamic few-shot text classification. GORAG constructs weighted keyword--label relations, retrieves candidate labels by connecting query keywords, and updates the graph as new labels and texts arrive~\cite{gorag-paper}. The system incorporates new information through index updates without requiring a predefined knowledge graph or model fine-tuning.

Large language models introduce another adaptation interface. GPT-3 demonstrates prediction from task descriptions and examples supplied in the prompt, without gradient updates for the demonstrated task~\cite{lit-brown2020language}. GORAG uses a language model for this prediction role, but maintains keyword--label associations in an external graph. Its online updates change which label evidence is retrieved for subsequent queries.

Natural Questions contains naturally occurring search queries with long and short answer annotations on Wikipedia pages, while TriviaQA pairs trivia questions with independently gathered evidence documents~\cite{lit-kwiatkowski2019natural,lit-joshi2017triviaqa}. MuSiQue constructs multihop questions by composing connected single-hop questions so that one reasoning step depends on information from another~\cite{lit-trivedi2022musique}. These collections help distinguish locating supporting text from reading or generating an answer from it.

title: TaPas: Weakly Supervised Table Parsing via Pre-training

locations.paragraph: Table pre-training can encode additional structural information. TURL learns contextual representations of relational tables through self-supervised pre-training~\cite{lit-deng2022turl}. TAPAS augments a language model with table-aware inputs and learns to answer questions through cell selection and aggregation~\cite{lit-herzig2020tapas}. TableFormer introduces learned attention biases for table structure and table--text alignment while addressing sensitivity to row and column order~\cite{lit-yang2022tableformer}. These designs show how serialization, structural biases, and pre-training tasks affect the table information available to a predictor.

title: OK-VQA: A Visual Question Answering Benchmark Requiring External Knowledge

locations.paragraph: The VQA task asks for an answer to a natural-language question about an image, making visual relevance depend on the question~\cite{lit-antol2015vqa}. OK-VQA adds questions that require knowledge beyond the image content~\cite{lit-marino2019okvqa}. MultiModalQA extends the evidence requirement to reasoning across source modalities. The distinction matters for retrieval because a visually informative image can still lack the particular detail or relationship requested by the question.

title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback

locations.paragraph: Instruction following can itself be learned through additional training. InstructGPT combines supervised demonstrations with reinforcement learning from human feedback to align model outputs with user instructions~\cite{lit-ouyang2022training}. A model used with fixed parameters at prediction time can therefore draw on instruction-following behavior learned before the downstream task.
